title: OpenAPI contract field names diverge from Pydantic schema field names
description: The generated OpenAPI auth-api.yaml uses 'username' for the login field, but the Pydantic TokenRequest model uses 'user_name', and the User entity uses 'user_name'. This field name mismatch will cause deserialization failures when the endpoint is implemented. The divergence occurred because the OpenAPI stub and the Pydantic schema were generated by different sub-agents without cross-referencing.
root_cause: Phase 3.2 Sub-Agent A generates Pydantic schemas from entity field names (user_name), while Phase 3.2 Sub-Agent B generates OpenAPI stubs independently using common conventions (username). There is no cross-validation step in Phase 3.4 (Reconcile) that checks field name consistency between OpenAPI specs and Pydantic schemas.
recommendation: In Phase 3.4 (Reconcile), add a cross-reference check: for each OpenAPI endpoint, verify that request/response schema field names match the corresponding Pydantic model field names. If FastAPI is the chosen framework, consider generating OpenAPI specs FROM FastAPI routes rather than maintaining separate YAML files — FastAPI auto-generates OpenAPI from Pydantic models, eliminating this class of errors by construction.
migration_note: Auto-marked applied during bootstrap → bootstrap_converge merge
